Drilbur

Ground

Unova · Generation 5

Drilbur is a Ground-type Mole Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 8.5 kg. It evolves into Excadrill. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 328.
